name: idle-compact
description: Compacts the main conversation once it has sat idle for idleMinutes, while the prompt cache is still warm, and hands every compaction of the main conversation (manual, auto, plugin, precompute) the Compact Instructions section of the user's AGENTS.md. Skips while a turn runs, below minMessageTokens of conversation, and past cutoffMinutes (a wake from sleep, when the cache has likely expired), saying which in the transcript; a reload of the plugin keeps the pending idle stretch.

idleMinutes.title: Idle minutes
idleMinutes.description: Minutes after the last answer of the main conversation before it is compacted. Keep it under the prompt cache lifetime (an hour on a subscription).

cutoffMinutes.title: Cutoff minutes
cutoffMinutes.description: Past this many minutes since the last answer the idle compaction is skipped: the timer fired late (sleep, a suspended process) and the cache has likely expired. Keep it above idleMinutes.

minMessageTokens.title: Minimum message tokens
minMessageTokens.description: Conversations whose messages (the Messages row of /context, without the system prompt, tools and memory files a compaction keeps) are smaller than this are not compacted on idle.

instructionsPath.title: Instructions file
instructionsPath.description: Markdown file whose Compact Instructions section is handed to every compaction. Empty: AGENTS.md in CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, else ~/.claude/AGENTS.md.
